Category rotation uses rolling 24-hour, 7-day, 30-day, and 365-day publication history; categories are normally spaced by at least 120 minutes and similar product families by 3 hours when comparable-demand alternatives exist. Medicines, pharmacy products, vitamins, and dietary supplements remain excluded. Confirmed deadlines require at least 60 minutes remaining; offers without a verified timer still require live stock, current price, and a meaningful verified discount.
